blocks.text: DSPM groups common threats into different categories. The policy violations are associated with a specific threat category and a severity level, allowing you to analyze the issue and take the necessary action.
DSPM defines the following threat categories:

table: User credentials are not secure (e.g., users without MFA).
Loss of data when some security controls are disabled (e.g., delete protection feature disabled, no backup) on the resource.
Data breach due to misconfigurations or vulnerabilities (e.g., encryption or logging is disabled on the resource, backup feature disabled).
